items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth.

Retain containment-only execution. Continue the existing dated evidence matrix and failed-work review using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, add dependencies, deploy, expand public exposure, create duplicate telemetry requests, or conduct external outreach.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence and failed-work containment only. Fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, so security-sensitive releases and public exposure remain blocked. Do not retrieve credentials, change permissions, access private containers, add dependencies, deploy, or create duplicate telemetry.
